# [Agent Substrate] Enforce Source Discussion Closeout Gate in `epic-resolution` (#11328 Part 2)

### What is the purpose of this issue?
Add a Source Discussion Closeout Gate to the `epic-resolution` skill to prevent Epic closure if upstream graduation criteria are unmet.

### What is the context?
This is part 2 of 3 to close the "Discussion-graduation enforcement gap" identified in the #11328 audit. Even if `epic-review` ensures a mapping exists, the final closeout of the Epic must verify that the mapped upstream criteria were actually achieved. Currently, `epic-resolution` only checks Epic ACs.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Update `.agents/skills/epic-resolution/SKILL.md` (and/or its `references/epic-resolution-workflow.md` audit file) to include a new **Source Discussion Closeout Gate**.
- [ ] Add the trigger condition: Fires when the Epic has a source Discussion or a Stage 2.5 mapping table.
- [ ] Require the `epic-resolution` workflow to reconcile upstream criteria before returning an Epic AC verdict.
- [ ] Enforce the failure mode: If any source Discussion criterion is not delivered, explicitly deferred, or converted into a follow-up ticket, the verdict MUST NOT be `CLOSE_AS_COMPLETED`.
- [ ] Define the valid alternative verdicts for this failure mode: e.g., `CREATE_MISSING_SUBS`, `KEEP_OPEN`, or `CLOSE_AS_PARTIAL_WITH_FOLLOW_UPS`.
